debit.notes: Customer Care Centre runs 24/7: inbound toll-free 1800 425 1809 and 1800 102 9408; NRI service centre (chargeable, for customers abroad) +91 484 6689600 / +91 484 2388555. Web: the OnlineCardBlock portal hotlists a Debit Card/Net Banking/Mobile Banking without login, validating account number + nationality + registered mobile number + captcha. Hotlisting email is ceghotlisting@sib.bank.in (the page's visible text; its mailto href still points at legacy ceghotlisting@sib.co.in); general 24/7 email customercare@sib.bank.in; nearest branch is the stated fallback. App: SIB Mirror+ is the bank's mobile-banking app (official page carries e-Lock lock/unlock and links only a Google Play search for 'SIB Mirror' — no direct app-store listing or in-app block menu path is published). No SMS block format is published on official pages; 1930 is not mentioned on the bank's pages.

credit.notes: SIB's retail credit card is the SIB OneCard co-brand. The bank's fraud-reporting page lists its block options: the onecard.southindianbank.bank.in credit-card services portal, the OneCard app (official deep link https://1cardapp.page.link/cardControls), IVR 18002109111, and email help@getonecard.app / reportfraud@fplabs.tech. The bank-level 24/7 toll-free numbers (1800 425 1809 / 1800 102 9408) are offered for reporting unauthorized transactions generally; no separate overseas line is published for OneCard. No SMS block format is published on official pages.
